through: Week 5 (last fully completed week; Week 6 games begin Sunday Oct 18, only the Thursday game has been played and is excluded). Injury news through Sat Oct 17 2026 4:45pm EDT.
scoring: PPR (FantasyPros stats pages, scoring=PPR). K and DST use FantasyPros scoring for those positions.
notes: season = total PPR points / games played in weeks 1-5 (summed from FantasyPros per-week stats pages, week=1..5); recent = mean of the last up to 4 games the player appeared in (weeks 1-5), so bye weeks and missed games are skipped.
Players chosen by total PPR points in weeks 1-5, capped per position: QB 36, RB 75, WR 100, TE 36, K 32, DST 32.

health comes only from the latest headline in FantasyPros injury-news (pages 1-8 of /nfl/injury-news.php, ~Oct 16 12am to Oct 17 4:45pm EDT; deeper pages repeat). Players with no headline in that window default to healthy, which means unknown, not confirmed healthy.
role is "steady" for all players: no usage/snap data was pulled, so rising/rotation/fringe was not assigned.
Team is the team shown on FantasyPros for the latest week the player appeared.
